additional_info.subject: RE: ID0415961-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312569868/06]Converter is broken CRM:02681000039
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0415961 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
We have checked last 2 weeks logs and found 600+ E17 error for PowerConverter[11], which indicates an internal communication error.
Please plan a site visit and check the CAN connections to the converter with serial number “2102312VGQKXN7001180”.
Also try swapping the faulty converter with the next one and check if the issue reappear on the same converter or on the swapped one.
If the issue reappear with swapped one (which was next to it), then there might be a wiring issue, then please check CAN communication connections.
or if the issue reappear on the same converter then there might be a converter issue, in that case you can proceed with the replacement.
Power Converter AC/DC 20kW > 8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2
